text:
Sofia: FYI Acme wants a 7-day POC for a customer-supplied model 'Orchid-XL-v3' + two runtime variants (fp16 & 4-bit). They want it on Dedicated with VPC peering and token-level cost reporting. Need pass/fail on tokenizer compatibility, license check, and quick cost estimate.

Noah: Do we have the repo/source? Is tokenizer spm or bpe? Also ask if they expect model uploads to our blob or if we should pull from their s3.

Sofia: Repo link in ticket: https://git.example/acme/orchid-xl tag v3-2026-03-20. Tokenizer is SentencePiece, model ~28B, stored as pytorch checkpoints. They indicated commercial use but license file ambiguous.

Ivy: Security note: if license is non-commercial we can't host. On-prem POC could be an option but extra fees and legal signoff. Also need their SOC2 summary before peering.

Noah: I'll do a quick probe run. Steps: clone, run tokenizer sanity, run a forward pass with our runtime shim. Posting commands now:

```
git clone https://git.example/acme/orchid-xl /tmp/orchid
python tools/check_tokenizer.py --model /tmp/orchid --prompt "Hello" --max-len 64
python tools/run_shim.py --model /tmp/orchid --dtype fp16 --seq 256 --batch 1
```

infra-bot: Ticket IN-8810 created: "Orchid-XL-v3 presales compatibility" assigned to @noah, watchers: @ivy, @amir, @sofia.

Noah: Quick results: tokenizer loads, but tokenization uses nbest sampling detokenization flags that differ from our default. Forward pass fails at kv-cache concat step: shapes show (seq, heads, head_dim) instead of (heads, seq, head_dim). I'll open a small adapter in runtime.

Amir: For Dedicated sizing: FP16 path -> 2xA100-80GB or 4xH100-80GB depending on throughput; 4-bit quant reduces footprint but we must validate quality. POC estimated infra cost ~4200 USD for 7 days with low tok/day. Add SE hours for conversion.

Ivy: License file is LICENSE-NONCOMM.md — flagged. I emailed Acme legal asking if they can provide a commercial license or grant us hosting rights for the POC. If they can't, we can discuss running the POC in their environment with our engineers.

Sofia: Action list: Noah -> runtime adapter + validated fp16 run; Amir -> provisional Dedicated pool + price list; Ivy -> SQA questionnaire draft + license clarification; I'll keep Acme engaged on legal. Can we target a readiness update by EOD?

Noah: Opened PR #5012 with a reshape adapter and tokenizer mapping tweak. FP16 test ok on a small input set. Still need to run full eval and then try quantization pipeline.

Amir: Provisioned preview pool id d-poc-999, will flip to reserved for the POC once legal confirms. Cost calc posted in ticket and shared with Sofia.

Ivy: SQA draft uploaded to the ticket. Called out network checklist for VPC peering and key rotation policy. Still waiting on Acme SOC2 pdf and clar on license.

Sofia: If Acme can relicense for commercial hosting, we proceed with 4-bit conversion and full POC. If not, offer on-prem run with additional compliance add-ons. Let's reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT. :clock9:
